description: Greece consumer prices for 61 individual grocery/food products — rice, bread, beef, milk, cheese, coffee and more — Eurostat's most granular CPI breakdown, since 2000 where the data goes back that far.

panels.title: Selected product: index over time (2015=100)
panels.description: Pick a product from the ${product} dropdown above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index
    WHERE country_iso3='GRC' AND source='eurostat' AND indicator='cpi_product_${product}'
      AND period_date >= '2000-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)
    ORDER BY 1
